notes_for_editor: Status and dating rest on undated or old notes: firelookout.com's 'Still there' has no date, and the most recent dated report is 2001 in a local list. The record's gone has no matching source in the cache (the FFLA list reads Abandoned), so the proposed correction to standing is a judgment; an editor may prefer unknown. The Josephine list's 'BLM?' suggests the manager is uncertain. Elevation 3,863 ft (1,177.4 m) matches the record. No photos. No access information found; access left unset. A current visit report or a 2020s photo would settle the status.
